title: Poker Home Game Rebuy Pressure Nights
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokerhome:session
| search rebuy_count=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(rebuy_count) as rebuys avg(net_result) as avg_net_result by _time venue_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks rebuy-heavy poker nights over time and breaks it out by venue.
value: Rebuy pressure helps distinguish a wild loose night from a more controlled social game.
implementation: Send rebuy-heavy poker nights events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of rebuy-heavy poker nights by venue.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how rebuy-heavy poker nights changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
